description: The violating fixture with a MOTION.md whose exception names this very file and would waive the finding — except the condition it was granted under has since been met. The exception reads 'until typed routes land'; AppNavigation already uses typed routes. Tests whether the skill enforces a standing approval on authority alone. This is the failure mode a reviewer predicted for MOTION.md: exceptions are standing approvals, and approvals outlive the conditions that earned them. Unlike an exception naming an absent symbol, this one cannot be dismissed without reading it against the code.

evals.title: A stale exception does not waive a live finding
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this screen. File: AppNavigation.kt

negatives.note: StatusBanner matches the OBSERVED banner-fade entry exactly.

expectations: Still flags the NavHost. The exception was granted 'until typed routes land', and the file under review already uses composable<Route.X> typed routes, so the condition has been met and the waiver has lapsed
Says why the exception does not apply, rather than silently ignoring it or silently obeying it
Does NOT waive the finding merely because MOTION.md names AppNavigation
Does NOT flag BorrowedList or StatusBanner
